verdicts.reason: The two layouts are nearly identical. In both, the can is shrunk to a tiny icon, the SOLSTICE logo is barely legible, and the tilted LONGEST DAY SALE ribbon is jammed into the lower-left corner apart from the brand. The legal copy wraps to three lines in the right column, nearly as big as the CTA label, and runs into a background dot. B wins narrowly because its Claim the Deal button lines up with the legal block's left edge, while A's button sits further left, out of alignment and crowding the headline.
